scope: Single released 60M scDFM checkpoint, human A549 chemical-condition continuation; no animal/source measurement or scaling claim.

roles.calibration_exposure: These six conditions were present in released-checkpoint pretraining; they are excluded only from this additional fitting.

ode.source_solver: Fixed Euler integration; the source implementation uses RK4 on 20 time-grid points.

nft.old_refresh: NFT decay_type1: min(.001*global_update,.5) EMA, after each completed generation/update round
nft.time_convention: scDFM tau=noise-to-data; NFT t=1-tau,v=-u; generated raw terminal is clean target, fresh independent corruption noise.
nft.advantage: One fixed condition/basal population prompt per round; center K population rewards, divide population-std+1e-4, clip to5.
nft.double_weights: Official detached float64 mean-absolute reconstruction denominators, clamp_min1e-5.

reward: Negative energy U between clipped generated population and the identical real fitting target population; one scalar per joint population.
primary: Test expected energy U; macro over seven chemical conditions, four fixed generation seeds; cells and genes are not independent tasks.
reference_penalty: All methods use the same 1e-4 current-vs-original velocity MSE and generation/corruption rules; each method's old-buffer values differ as its policy changes.
native_fm: Four real-target native Gaussian FM + one-step MMD(.5) losses per update; same four old-policy rollout seeds are generated for monitoring and the common reference penalty.
terminal_gradient: Same terminal energy and reference penalty; replay same four initial noise seeds with live-model differentiable Euler and activation checkpointing. Extra replay/backward compute is reported, not equated to NFT FLOPs.
modes: live/old/original reference all eval-mode, retaining live autograd, to disable scDFM .1 dropout and preserve neutral-advantage cancellation.
precision: float32 weights and activations; TF32 matrix multiplications enabled/high precision; NFT weight reductions float64.
numeric_compatibility: Frozen old/reference velocities use detached leaf parameter views in torch.func.functional_call with autograd enabled, then outputs detach immediately. Original frozen parameters remain unchanged and receive no gradients. This matches live CUDA kernels: development initial velocity difference and neutral-advantage parameter gradients were exactly zero with TF32 enabled or disabled.
selection: No hyperparameter or update selection; all coefficients fixed before formal fitting. Calibration is descriptive and evaluated before final test.

preprocessing.normalization: counts layer -> scanpy.normalize_total(default target_sum=None; per-cell total target median) ->log1p ->highly_variable_genes(n_top_genes5000), exact original var order
preprocessing.drug_dictionary: np.unique individual drug tokens split by+ then sorted, includescontrol; fromalloriginalconditions asofficialpipeline
preprocessing.graph: only official_train X -> officialhelper preprocess_expression(defaultlog1pTrue,zscoreTrue) ->safepearson ->abs signedcorrelations ->topk30 symmetric ->MHA disallowmask ->officialsorted_pad_mask(pad4); helpersecondlog1p preserved
preprocessing.graph_source: https://arxiv.org/html/2602.07103 AppendixA.4.3 explicitlyCombo kNN30signed; originalmaskfile not released; deterministic reconstruction rather than originalmaskbyteverification
preprocessing.pubchem_skipped: compoundannotation/fingerprints unused by thisreleaseddrugIDmodel; noPubChemAPI calls
preprocessing.transductive_boundary: originalauthors HVG5000 usesallcells, evaluationHVG1000 usesoriginaltest+control; maintained for checkpointcontract and explicitlynot newlytrainonlyfeatureselection
preprocessing.biological_unit: A549chemicalcombinations; sample one sciPlex_theislabel; no donorcolumn, wellmetadataretained; do not treatcellsasindependentbiologicalreplicates

limitations: Original 5000-HVG and test1000-HVG axes follow author transductive preprocessing; not a new training-only feature-selection claim.
Original seven test labels may have been used for checkpoint selection by source authors; this is not independently reconstructed pretraining isolation.
Six additional-calibration conditions were seen in original pretraining.
N4 fitting populations and one A549 context; one optimization seed; no biological-replicate uncertainty.
63k is original dataset size, not this continuation's actual label count.
NFT loss is an adaptation to scDFM; no SD3/image-experiment reproduction, likelihood-ratio, PPO or exact-KL claim.
Energy U may be negative; intervals condition on fitted predictions and the fixed feature/readout contract.
